A '''puerquito''' is a pig-shaped molasses cookie that heals {{Hp|4}} and grants {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for 30 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/puerquito.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Molasses]], sugar, estus ash and dough make 2. Obtaining molasses unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a puerquito takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|4}} and gives Regeneration I for 0:30.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].
